audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0-2 read Skill and row 3 read Trundle, and whys[4] described 'Level 5' on the row labelled Level 6.
audit.why: Sett's double-punch beats Chomp, which only saps AD, through the first three levels; from 4-5 Pillar of Ice makes it a positioning question; Trundle takes over at first item once Frozen Domain and Subjugate are online.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Sett, Sett, Sett, Skill, Skill, Trundle, Trundle with inverse ratings 6/7/7/5/5/3/3, matching the already-audited mirror. whys[1], whys[3] and whys[4] rewritten to fit their new rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 had no numbers and the wrong level in its why text.
audit.why: Subjugate is 120s at rank 1 and the steal DOUBLES over the following 4 seconds — so he wants to open with it, and you want the fight after it is spent.
audit.corrected: whys[4], breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d all carry the 120s and the 4-second doubling.

audit.whatIsWrong: Pillar of Ice was called his W in three places, and nothing said what beats the Subjugate steal.
audit.why: Pillar of Ice is E — 21s at rank 1, 1000 range, impassable terrain. Frozen Domain is the W. And Subjugate steals Health, Armor and Magic Resist, none of which reduces Haymaker's true-damage centre, which is the one thing that keeps landing at full value after he ults you.
audit.corrected: Slots fixed in mid and wants.you[0]; the true-damage answer written into report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns.
sources: champ-data/_kits/trundle.json (E cd 21/19.5/18/16.5/15 range 1000; W; R text)

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told you to respect 'his Q AD shred' but never said Chomp is an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: The reset means his burst arrives on the wind-up, not on the cast — reading the cast is a beat too late.
audit.corrected: Written into dontsFull[2].d with the 3.5s cooldown; King's Tribute's minion-death healing moved into dosFull[2].d, which is titled 'Anti-heal his sustain' and previously carried unrelated boilerplate.

edits.before: - Trundle Subjugate: matchup-defining — Steals your stats. All-in when it’s down. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Trundle Subjugate: 120s at rank 1 — it steals health, armour and MR, and doubles over 4s. Your W centre is true damage.

edits.before: Steals your stats. All-in when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 120s at rank 1 and it doubles over 4s — commit only once he has spent it.

edits.before: Trundle wastes Subjugate — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Executioner's first: King's Tribute heals him off every minion death.

edits.before: Track Trundle's Subjugate: Steals your stats. All-in when it’s down. When it is down — E-stun + W him.
edits.after: Subjugate steals armour and MR, but Haymaker's centre is true damage — it lands at full value anyway.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Pillar of Ice is 21s at rank 1 and 1000 range — it cuts your walk-up.

edits.before: Dumping autos into Trundle with an empty grit bar and no E — your W hits like a pillow and he just out-trades you on cooldowns.
edits.after: Chomp is a 3.5s auto-attack reset that saps your AD — the wind-up is your cue to step back, and Frozen Domain heals him while he grinds.

edits.before: Level 2 Trundle's Pillar of Ice walls off and kites your trades.
edits.after: Level 2 your double punch beats Chomp, which only saps AD.

edits.before: Level 4-5 his Q shred and pillar make trades favor him.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 hinge on whether Pillar of Ice cuts your walk-up.

edits.before: Level 5 is skill-based on whether you bait his W and R.
edits.after: At 6 Subjugate doubles its steal over 4s — bait it first.

edits.before: Level 3 you get a clean all-in window if his W is down, though from level 4 onward his Q shred and Frozen Domain sustain make the mid-game skill-dependent.
edits.after: Level 3 you get a clean all-in if Pillar of Ice is down — 21s at rank 1 — though from 4 his Chomp AD-sap and Frozen Domain sustain even the mid-game.

edits.before: Bait his W pillar before committing your E-pull and Haymaker
edits.after: Bait Pillar of Ice (E, 21s) before your pull and Haymaker
